liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Steam Engine** (1 review): Reviewer lists this track, alongside I’m Amazed and Wordless Chorus, as a highlight [8]
- **Phone Went West** (1 review): Reviewer says the pre-encore finale of this song broke their brain [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **August 2022 (Saturday)**: rare: 4 archived performances [9]
- **The Day Is Coming**: back after 35 archived shows (1379 days) [9]
- **Lucky To Be Alive**: rare: 14 archived performances [9]
- **Strangulation!**: back after 62 archived shows (2131 days) [9]
- **I Never Could Get Enough**: rare: 4 archived performances [9]
- **Complex**: rare: 6 archived performances [9]
- **Phone Went West > We'll Meet Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Rocket Man**: rare: 12 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **mmj2022-08-27.leary** (recommended): source not stated; 25 songs; 168 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the final ninety minutes the greatest performance they have ever witnessed [5]
- **mmj2022-08-27.Schoeps_mk4v_flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 170 min [2]
- **mmj2022-08-27.Schoeps_mk22_flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 170 min [3]

## Around the show

- Joy Oladokun opened the show, marking the reviewer's first Red Rocks experience with the band [6]
- This was the second of two nights at the venue, with Joy Oladokun opening [1]
- Reviewer, having attended over two hundred Red Rocks shows, calls this the greatest concert of their life [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2022-08-27.leary**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: DPA 4023 > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [1]
- **mmj2022-08-27.Schoeps_mk4v_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk4v>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ 24bit/96khz DIN [2]. Also: Recorded by Andy Murray using a Sonosax SX-R4+ clamped to the side of the stage; Audio processed in Reaper on a MacBook Pro, then tagged and exported as FLAC [2]
- **mmj2022-08-27.Schoeps_mk22_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk22>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ 24bit/96khz NOS [3]
